headline: Weekend CME halt covers the full window after Friday's two-sided close: hawkish Jackson Hole keynote, Chicago PMI 47.1, NDX 29,433.43 (-0.70%), VIX 14.43
body: CME Globex has been halted since Friday 21:00 UTC and does not reopen until Sunday 30 August at 22:00 UTC, so every hour of this forecast window is a closed venue with no Nasdaq-100 price discovery. Verified pre-halt evidence re-checked this run: cash NDX closed 29,433.43, down 0.70 percent, inside a 29,383.92 to 29,752.78 range against a 29,641.56 previous close; NQ futures last printed 29,491.75, down 0.69 percent, in a 29,436.75 to 29,811.50 range; VIX finished at 14.43 within a 14.13 to 14.84 range. Friday delivered a two-sided macro shock. Fed Chair Warsh's Jackson Hole keynote was read as hawkish, with Reuters reporting the 2-year yield up about 11 basis points to 4.34 percent and September rate-hike odds rising from roughly 35 percent to about 60 percent; a separate briefing places the 2-year near 4.32 percent and the 10-year at 4.72 percent into the close, while official H.15 readings for 27 August are 2Y 4.20 percent and 10Y 4.67 percent. Against that, the August Chicago PMI collapsed to 47.1 from 57.6 versus consensus near 57.9, a drop of about 10.5 points into contraction. That combination is stagflationary in shape and is treated here as a Stress and Confidence input, not as evidence of the persistent one-way index path Tail measures. Internals were dispersed rather than aligned: the Dow finished roughly flat while the S&P 500 fell 0.25 percent to 7,711.76 and the Nasdaq Composite lost 0.52 percent, as hyperscalers advanced and chipmakers retreated, with Nvidia about 3 percent lower after an 8.7 percent post-earnings gain the prior session. The dollar index rose 0.50 percent to 99.65, gold fell about 3 percent to near 4,455 dollars, and WTI sits near 83.44 dollars after a weekly decline of about 4 percent, with Brent reported near 89.31 dollars. The shared cross-asset context file was last collected at 02:28 UTC, outside its 90-minute freshness window, so it is excluded as current structure evidence and this assessment rests on independently verified sources. No pathological price path can form while the venue is closed, so Tail is held at 5 across the window, the dominant mode is normal in every slot, and no danger window is defined. Stress runs 25 to 29 as unpriced weekend information accumulates, and Confidence eases from 79 to 73 purely as Friday's prints age. The Jackson Hole symposium is scheduled to conclude with Saturday panels, and any commentary would remain unpriced until the reopen. The next evidence checkpoint is the Globex reopen on Sunday 30 August at 22:00 UTC, beyond this window, followed by the 1 to 4 September catalyst stack of ISM Manufacturing and JOLTS, ADP and the Beige Book, jobless claims and trade balance, ISM Services and August payrolls.

lookbackSummary: The preceding 24 hours cover Friday's full session and the first hours of the weekend halt. Tail ran 11 to 13 with Stress in the low-to-mid 50s through the Asian and European hours as positioning built ahead of the Jackson Hole keynote. The mode shifted to event/whipsaw from 14:00 UTC as the Chicago PMI miss and then the keynote hit the tape, and Tail peaked at 22 with Stress at 64 in the 16:00 to 19:00 UTC block; the mapped policy state never exceeded WATCH because retracements kept occurring. After the 20:00 UTC cash close the readings decayed quickly, Tail from 12 to 5 and Stress from 52 to 24, as the venue entered the weekend closure and the mode reverted to normal. One hour, 10:00 UTC on 28 August, has no published assessment and is marked unavailable.
outlookSummary: Every hour of the forecast window falls inside the CME weekend halt, so no Nasdaq-100 price path can form and Tail is held at 5 in all 24 slots, keeping the mapped policy state at EA_ON throughout with no danger window. Stress runs 25 to 29 in the moderate band as unpriced weekend information accumulates, carrying the unresolved September policy question, Friday's Chicago PMI contraction, and the 1 to 4 September catalyst stack of ISM Manufacturing and JOLTS, ADP and the Beige Book, jobless claims and trade balance, ISM Services and August payrolls. Confidence eases from 79 to 73 purely as Friday's verified prints age; coverage of levels, yields, volatility, oil and the calendar is complete but cannot be refreshed until the venue reopens. The dominant mode is normal in every slot because a closed market has no structure to classify. Weekend headline and gap exposure accumulates across the window, and the Jackson Hole symposium is scheduled to end with Saturday panels, but the Globex reopen on Sunday 30 August at 22:00 UTC lies beyond the final slot, so reopening structure is explicitly not forecast here.
